name: Incident Postmortem
description: Blameless incident review template for operational incidents, outages, and reliability events.

sections.title: Incident Summary
sections.instruction: Provide a concise overview of what happened, when it happened, and the current status

sections.title: Impact
sections.instruction: Describe affected users, systems, regions, business impact, severity, and duration

sections.title: Timeline
sections.instruction: List key timestamps from detection through mitigation and resolution

sections.title: Root Cause & Contributing Factors
sections.instruction: Summarize the root cause, proximate causes, contributing conditions, and detection gaps without assigning blame

sections.title: What Went Well
sections.instruction: List effective responses, tools, processes, or communication patterns observed during the incident

sections.title: What Could Improve
sections.instruction: List process, tooling, monitoring, ownership, or communication improvements identified

sections.title: Corrective Actions
sections.instruction: List concrete remediation items with owners, priorities, due dates, and verification criteria
